title: Claude Opus 5 matches Fable on coding at half the price, and Anthropic says it is the most aligned model it has ever shipped

content_html:
TL;DR

Claude Opus 5 tops Fable 5 on most benchmarks at half the token price and is Anthropic’s most aligned model to date

Anthropic on Thursday released Claude Opus 5, a model that matches or exceeds its flagship Fable 5 on most coding and knowledge-work benchmarks at half the token price. The model is the fourth Anthropic has shipped in under two months, following Fable 5 in early June, Sonnet 5 at the end of June, and now Opus 5 on July 24. It costs $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, the same price as its predecessor.

On Frontier-Bench, a coding evaluation that measures whether models can build working software from engineering drawings, Opus 5 more than doubles its predecessor’s score and surpasses every competing model, including Fable 5. On ARC-AGI 3, which tests novel problem-solving, Opus 5 scores roughly three times higher than the next-best model. On Zapier AutomationBench, which measures whether models can complete real business tasks end to end, Opus 5 passes more tasks than any rival even at its lowest effort setting.

Anthropic says Opus 5 is also its most aligned model to date, with the lowest rate of deceptive behaviour recorded in its automated safety audit. Its predecessor set a new bar for honesty when it launched in late May, and Opus 5 pushes that bar further while remaining behind Mythos 5 on offensive cybersecurity tasks. Anthropic says it intentionally avoided training the model on cyber work, though it has improved on those tasks as a side effect of becoming more generally capable.

The model is available today as the new default on Claude Max and the strongest model on Claude Pro. Developers can access it through the API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry. A Fast mode runs at two and a half times the default speed for double the base price, and two new API features ship alongside it: mid-conversation tool changes that let developers swap tools without breaking the prompt cache, and automatic fallbacks that route flagged requests to a different model instead of blocking them.

The release pace tells a broader story about where the AI model market is headed. Anthropic has gone from shipping one flagship per quarter to four models in roughly eight weeks, each targeting a different price-performance slot. Opus 5 fills the gap between the expensive Fable tier and the budget-friendly Sonnet tier, offering near-frontier intelligence for everyday coding and knowledge work without the cybersecurity restrictions that limit Fable or the access constraints that keep Mythos behind closed doors.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Claude Opus 5 在大多数基准测试中均以代币价格一半的价格领先于 Fable 5，并且是 Anthropic 迄今为止最一致的模型

Anthropic 周四发布了 Claude Opus 5，该模型在大多数编码和知识工作基准上都与旗舰产品 Fable 5 相匹配或超过，而代币价格却只有一半。 该模型是 Anthropic 在不到两个月内发布的第四款模型，之前是 6 月初的《神鬼寓言 5》、6 月底的《Sonnet 5》和 7 月 24 日的《Opus 5》。 每百万个输入代币的成本为 5 美元，每百万个输出代币的成本为 25 美元，与其前身价格相同。

在 Frontier-Bench（一种衡量模型是否可以根据工程图构建工作软件的编码评估）上，Opus 5 的得分是其前身的两倍多，并超越了包括《神鬼寓言 5》在内的所有竞争模型。 在测试新问题解决能力的 ARC-AGI 3 上，Opus 5 的得分大约是次优模型的三倍。 在 Zapier AutomationBench（衡量模型是否能够端到端完成实际业务任务）上，Opus 5 即使在最低工作量设置下也比任何竞争对手通过了更多的任务。

Anthropic 表示，Opus 5 也是迄今为止最一致的模型，其自动安全审计中记录的欺骗行为率最低。 它的前身在 5 月底推出时为诚实设定了新的标准，而 Opus 5 进一步推动了这一标准，同时在进攻性网络安全任务上仍然落后于 Mythos 5。 Anthropic 表示，它有意避免对网络工作模型进行训练，尽管它已经改进了这些任务，作为变得更普遍能力的副作用。

该型号现已上市，作为 Claude Max 的新默认型号和 Claude Pro 的最强型号。 开发人员可以通过 API、Amazon Bedrock、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Foundry 访问它。 快速模式的运行速度是默认速度的两倍半，基本价格是两倍，并且同时提供了两个新的 API 功能：对话中工具更改，使开发人员可以在不破坏提示缓存的情况下交换工具，以及自动回退，将标记的请求路由到不同的模型而不是阻止它们。

发布速度讲述了有关人工智能模型市场走向的更广泛的故事。 Anthropic 已经从每季度推出一款旗舰产品增加到大约八周内推出四种型号，每种型号都针对不同的性价比。 Opus 5 填补了昂贵的《Fable》层和经济实惠的 Sonnet 层之间的空白，为日常编码和知识工作提供近乎前沿的智能，而不受《Fable》的网络安全限制或《Mythos》的访问限制。
